uncited: **Global Transformation:** Compute the 3D Discrete Hartley Transform (DHT) of the volume.
The 1D DHT for a sequence $h_k$ of length $N$ is applied separably along each dimension.
**Slice Extraction:** Define a 2D plane passing through the origin of the frequency domain and perpendicular to the viewing direction vector $V$.
Resample the 3D spectrum onto this 2D plane to obtain the 2D slice $I(u, v)$.
**Inverse Transformation:** Compute the 2D Inverse Discrete Hartley Transform (IDHT) of the slice $I(u, v)$ to generate the final projection image.
